capacity.capacity_formula: max(1, ceil(capacity_factor * batch_size * sequence_length * top_k / num_experts))
capacity.no_drop: remove capacity rejection only; preserve top-k, full softmax, selected gate, expert, residual and downstream rerouting
capacity.overflow_order: descending selected gate confidence per expert using native topk(capacity), unchanged
capacity.unit: all token positions in the complete original input batch at each MoE layer

interpretation_limits: K and J are controlled checkpoint-evaluation contrasts, not uniquely attributable mediation effects.
No outcome is a training run without capacity limits.
The repeated validation set is not an independent test set.
Seeds are the only independent replication units; tokens, batches, experts, and layers are not independent replications.
No seed selection, threshold, clamping, or winner classifier is used.
purpose: checkpoint-only controlled evaluation of native versus capacity rejection disabled

source_paths.uploaded_shared_only_diagnostics: definitions audited from the attached CSV header and scripts/imp_postpruning_adaptation_v1/diagnostics.py

validation.batching: identical original canonical 31-batch sequence per seed, including partial last batch
validation.loss: task cross-entropy, summed NLL divided by total target tokens
